Exploring All the Possibilities
UM-Dearborn offers the prestige of a Michigan degree within a smaller campus atmosphere. Whether you’re pursuing a bachelor’s or entering a graduate program, you’ll become part of a diverse academic community located in the heart of the American Midwest.
As an international student at UM-Dearborn, you’ll have close faculty mentorship, access to real-world learning experiences, premier career development assistance and many opportunities to get involved with classmates from around the world.
